start_gate: Predecessor passed plus independent final verification; implement and validate a separate objective adapter; pass pilot resource and numerical gates. No automatic launch installed by this plan.

tracks.historical: Match predecessor sealed data/inventory; exploratory because previous results informed proposal
tracks.prospective: Separately seal future untouched dates and latest confirmed inventory before execution

objective.primary: Maximise candidate-dependent terminal forecast netSD subject to expected terminal account return >= rho(alpha)
tie_breaks: Maximise expected return at maximal netSD
Minimise turnover after the first two objectives
objective.denominator: Recompute on augmented reference network for every candidate
objective.OOS: Not available for outer optimisation or parameter selection

grid.weighted_sum: Pilot sensitivity only; lambda is distinct from alpha
grid.certificate: Attained nondominated approximation unless global optimality is independently certified

pilot.origin_selection: Chronological coverage without looking at performance outcomes

primary_budget.assumptions: 222 origins; 4 groups; excludes extra robustness experiments; actual cache reuse reported separately
primary_budget.ETA_gate: Measure pilot throughput, memory, time distributions and energy before full expansion

stability.strict_common_buy: positive additional purchase at every registered uniform-grid point
stability.avoid: No-sale inherited holdings are not evidence of a stable new BUY; sampled commonality is not a global guarantee
stability.consensus_policy: Optional separately validated feasible projection selected on IS only

compute.safety: Preserve numerical tolerances; admission checks separate from diagnostic sampling; no active solver changes

inference.dependence: Calendar-block resampling with block-length sensitivity; not independent overlapping folds
inference.regime: IS-only decision filters; retrospective labels diagnostic only

final_wealth: One self-financing weekly receding-horizon execution path; never compound overlapping one-month tests
